section.title: Turn checkpoints
section.subtitle: One workspace snapshot before and after each turn, stored under ~/.dsc without touching your own .git
field.enabled.label: Enable turn snapshots
field.enabled.help: When off, no new snapshots are taken; the ones already stored are kept, and turning it back on resumes from the next turn.
field.maxRepoMB.label: Shadow repository limit (MB)
field.maxRepoMB.help: Snapshots stop once the repository exceeds this size, and the conversation says so once; raising the limit resumes them on the next turn.
field.listLimit.label: Rows shown by /checkpoint list
field.listLimit.help: Only affects how many rows are listed, not how many snapshots are kept (nothing is deleted by this limit).
field.repo.label: Shadow repository location
save.unknownKey: This section has no such setting: {key}
command.label: Snapshot
command.description: Show the checkpoint repository and recent snapshots; restore rewinds the workspace to before a turn while keeping your own edits
